## Description
Provide a brief summary of the changes introduced in this pull request and the rationale behind them.

## Related Issues
Closes #[issue number]

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Performance optimization or refactor
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the project's coding standards and conventions

- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation accordingly
- [ ] My changes pass all unit tests (`npm test`)
- [ ] Multi-context E2E tests pass if collaboration was modified (`npm run test:e2e`)
- [ ] No new warnings or lint errors generated
